fixed_stencil_support.limitations: The contact geometry and existing stencil are fixed. Positive feasibility supplies possible static wrenches, not deformation/contact convergence. Negative certificates exclude only this fixed stencil's admissible force distributions; additional contacts, deformation and pose changes can alter support. Force/moment checks use the linear FEM reference rigid modes, with two x-free guided backplates. No general grasp infeasibility or resolved-contact acceptance is claimed.

limitations: Two full3D U free-body force-controlled contact pilots meet unchanged equilibrium gates after spatial refinement. Actual raw native full tensors and nodal replay match independent contact-body elasticity. Fixed-stencil cone certificates do not exclude contact birth or pose changes. Original interpreter-exit and figure-QA failures remain exact. Local pads reach5–6% linear strain, so nonlinear compliance, contact spatial/regularization/history tails, finite-footprint replay, rigid feedback and full egg/Franka matching remain required. Live finer-U and egg jobs are outside this immutable checkpoint. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
